translation.name: Kazuwamgbani ka savu n Tsikimba n aɓon a ɗa a ɗanga̱sai a kazuwamgbani ka cau

book.name: Roma
book.title: Ukanikorongi Ubana a Asu u Aza a Roma

content: Na̱ka̱i kaci ka ɗe asu u Kashila̱

Ama a va̱, an u wokoi Kashila̱ ka̱ri n asuvayali ɗa i zuwai ma folo ɗa̱ i na̱ka̱ kaci ka ɗe a asu u Kashila̱ yavu eɗa̱ uɗara̱kpa u ɗa, shegai uɗara̱kpa u ɗa wa̱ri n uma. Na̱ka̱i kaci ka ɗe i rongo uwulukpi n i zuwusi yi upana kayanyan. Naha ɗa u gain i lyaka Kashila̱ kayala a asuvu a atakasuvu a ɗe.

Kotsu i lyai kapala n i yanyi ili iꞌya ama a likimba a na a ka yansa wa, shegai i gono i a̱sa̱ka̱ Kashila̱ ka na̱ka̱ ɗa̱ atakasuvu a savu. Pini nala, ɗa ya reve ili iꞌya Kashila̱ ka ciga ɗa̱ i yain: ya reve ta̱ ili iꞌya i lobonoi, n ili iꞌya u tsu pana kayanyan, n tyoku ɗa ili yi i gain i woko.

Kashila̱ ka wenike mu ta̱ ukuna u shinga, adama a nala n tonuko ta̱ ya dem asuvu a ɗe: kotsu vu bidya kaci ka vunu yavu vu la tyoku ɗa va̱ri wa, shegai vu gono vu yawunsa mai, vu zuwa kaci ka vunu a una̱ u upityanangu u ɗa Kashila̱ ka na̱ka̱ vu.
Tsa̱ ta̱ n apashi ushani uɓolomgbonusi a ikyamba i te, kpam ko ka eni ka wa ka̱ ta̱ n manyan ma ne kau.
Nala dem, tsa̱ ta̱ ushani, shegai ya dem kapashi ka ikyamba ka Kawauwi ka, kpam a̱tsu dem tsa̱ ta̱ uɓolomgboni n uza n utoku.

Kashila̱ ka ne ta̱ ya dem a asuvu a tsunu kune kau‑kau ka wa yanka manyan. U na̱ka̱ tsu baci ucira u ɗa tsa yan kuɓari ku akani a ne, she tsu yansa̱ka u ɗa manyan n gba̱ upityanangu u ɗa tsa̱ri n u ɗa.
U na̱ka̱ tsu baci ucira u gbashika, she tsu gbasha. U na̱ka̱ tsu baci ucira u uwenishike, tsu wenishike.

U na̱ka̱ tsu baci ucira u ugbamatangusu asuvu a ama, she tsu gbamatangusu asuvu. U na̱ka̱ tsu baci ucira u maneke, she tsu neke n katakasuvu ka te. Kashila̱ ka na̱ka̱ vu baci ucira u utono n ama, she vu ma̱tsa̱ vu yain u ɗa mai. Va pana̱sa baci ama asuvayali, she vu yain u ɗa n ipeli.
Ahali a shinga
Ciga atoku n uciga u mayun. Kovo ili i cingi, aku vu ka̱na̱ ili i shinga.
Cigamgbanai tyoku ɗa uza n vangu u ne a gain a cigamgbana. Vu ma̱tsa̱ vu wenike atoku karinga̱.
Kotsu vu woko kawonvoli wa, shegai vu yain manyan cika. Na̱ka̱ kaci ka vunu gba̱ a asu u ugbashika Asheku.
Lya kapala n ipeli kpaci va̱ ta̱ n uzuwa u uma. Va̱ baci n kadambula, she vu yain ahankuri. Vu yansa kavasu maco.
Na̱ka̱ ama a Kashila̱ iꞌya a nambai. Vu wushi amoci aza ɗa aꞌa̱ri Atoni a kuwa ku vunu.
Ama a zuwa vu baci vu soi mavura an va̱ri Katoni, vu yanka le una̱ u cingi wa, shegai vu gono vu yanka le kavasu Kashila̱ ka zuwuka le una̱ u shinga.
Pele n ama ɗa a ka pele, kpam vu sa̱i n ama ɗa a ka sa̱.
Dusuku ndishi n shinga n atoku a vunu, yan tsije n aza ɗa bawu aꞌa̱ri ili i roku. Yan n ara̱ɗi wa, ko kpam vu bidya kaci ka vunu uza u ugboji wa.
Uza roku u yanka vu baci tsicingi, vu tsupa yi n tsicingi wa. Ma̱tsa̱ vu yain ili iꞌya ya dem bidyai iꞌa̱ri mai.
Vu yain tyoku u ufuɗa u vunu vu rongo na̱ ndishi n shinga n ama.
Aje a va̱, ama nusuka ɗa̱ baci, kotsu i dana ya yan le mavura wa, shegai i vana Kashila̱ ka yan le mavura n asuvu a upan u ne. Magono ma Zuba ma dana ta̱ a Tagara̱da u Kashila̱,

content.text: “Ma yan ta̱ aza ɗa a nusai mavura.
Ma tsupa le ta̱ a kaci ka ili iꞌya a yain.”

content: Shegai i gono i yain ili iꞌya Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u danai:

content.text: “Utokulalu u vunu wa pana baci kambulu, lyatangi yi.
Wa pana baci kakuli, ne yi mini u soi.
Pini nala, ɗa wa pana uwono u ili iꞌya u yanka vu.”

content: Kotsu vu a̱sa̱ka̱ tsicingi tsu lya vu wa, lya kaci ka tsicingi a asu u uyan tsishinga.
